action_base_rate_control.interpretation: If action_id_only ~= v3_full, the above-chance LOO is a per-action-type base rate (clicks act, arrows often do not), NOT the frame representation carrying state-grounded action-effect signal. The frame representation is adequate for the dynamics sub-task only if frame features beat this control by a real margin.

field_principles.action_base_rate_control: the adversarial control: action-id-alone LOO. If it matches v3_full, the signal is a trivial per-action base rate, not the frame representation -- guards against overclaiming perception.
field_principles.corpus_checksum: content hash of (features,label) rows; catches silent corpus drift on replay.
field_principles.duration_s: wall-clock of corpus build + LOO eval; substrate is offline env-stepping + a linear classifier (no LLM/GPU), so the 1s cached-candidate floor applies.
field_principles.false_negative_risk_checked: a LOO null is valid only if the in-sample control passed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal prefix; success: above-chance LOO with CI excluding 0.5, else complete: honest null.
field_principles.in_sample_auroc: POSITIVE CONTROL; must exceed 0.5 or the harness is broken and a null is uninformative (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK guard).
field_principles.loo_auroc_ci: bootstrap CI on per-game LOO AUROC; above-chance requires CI to exclude 0.5.
field_principles.loo_auroc_mean: HEADLINE -- mean leave-one-GAME-out AUROC; the only cross-game (not cross-frame) evidence the representation transfers to a hidden game.
field_principles.missing_verifier_gaps: if the representation is at chance, the missing discriminator is the input to the verifier-build backlog (Missing-Verifier Gap Logging).
field_principles.positive_control_passed: in-sample AUROC > 0.5 guards a silently-broken harness.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records resources verified before the run.
field_principles.representation_under_test: must be the live-path featurizer, not a hypothetical richer one (ARC Live-Path Reachability Discipline).
field_principles.target: action-effect is the DYNAMICS half of world-model induction; exp4545 measured the value/goal half. Both must carry signal for induction to be posed on adequate features.
field_principles.v2_order1_loo_auroc: the order-1 baseline this re-tests (exp4545 value-target: 0.494).
field_principles.v3_full_loo_auroc: the CURRENT live representation's ceiling on the dynamics target.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: false -- label is raw pixel-change ground truth, oracle-DISTINCT from the LEARNED DiscriminativeVerifier scoring the features.

representation_under_test: cross_game_features_v3 (the live-path featurizer); live value head ships the v2_plus_frame_delta subset
